sections.title: Command registry
sections.content: Defines red/green pytest programs for canonical evidence, migration, runtime policy, acceptance pipeline, projection/segmentation, semantic import, and rollout regression. Terminal validation runs all owner-owned green programs. Commands are non-shell, repository-root scoped, timeout-bounded, and map to ARBE acceptance IDs.

sections.title: Requirements and acceptance
sections.content: Defines ARBE-001 through ARBE-022 and observable criteria ARBE-A01 through ARBE-A46. Core requirements cover identity-bound admission, changed-set and consumer closure, real checks and route policy, isolated roles, immutable projections and segments, runtime progress/retry controls, cost decisions, Bootstrap import authority, canonical-evidence migration, historical evidence, rollout metrics, acceptance mode/route matrix, and advisory-only external review material.
